meaning: Public evidence is unnecessarily hard to find or inspect
examples: broken link; missing README; unclear canonical repo; inaccessible artifact

meaning: Concrete public artifact demonstrates work named by this requisition
examples: agent harness; sandbox; orchestration; eval; runtime debugging; observability; compiler/runtime; developer platform

meaning: Concrete systems work bears on the role but is not the same task
examples: build/release systems; native runtime boundary; reliable deployment; state machine; kernel work

meaning: Real evidence differentiates the profile but is not materially about this role
examples: unrelated mathematics; unusual domain project; hobby artifact

meaning: Easy filtering signal that is not itself evidence of doing this work
examples: stars; follower count; prestige; school name; years as a scalar; repository count; inferred personality

meaning: Material role question not answered by inspected public evidence
examples: production scale; authorship; Rust depth; GPU/inference work; team collaboration

meaning: Highest-information bounded follow-up that could resolve an unknown
examples: open a test; inspect CI; inspect release; inspect a relevant PR; inspect source around claimed subsystem
